data.body:
Three-stage pre-push review — APPROVED.

Stage 1 / spec compliance: PASS. Every implementation AC maps to code and a gating test: static product-path replay covers all 178 bodies and 1,383 ordered settling conversions; the historical byte oracle still covers all 884 prepared units; cardinality, scrub, protection, table, HTML-comment, determinism, settling, richness, alignment, dispatch, fallback, and immutability assertions remain; three evidence-selected real bodies cover code_arrow/table/prose; the compact version/platform/argv/stdin/timeout probes remain; the external workflow adds weekly/manual ubuntu-latest and macos-latest full replay; generation and non-writing validation are explicit. ADR 0096 and docs/architecture.md compliance: PASS. Gerrit timing, votes, and merge ACs are lifecycle evidence pending the push, not missing implementation.

Stage 2 / code quality: PASS. The static converter is fail-closed on unmapped prepared input, duplicate input disagreements fail, canonical artifacts are deterministic and below the file-size gate, the check path never writes, and provenance mismatches fail the gate. No new dependency, production code, skip, xfail, weakened assertion, or speculative abstraction was introduced. The complete diff and all changed files were inspected; git diff --check, lint/actionlint, typecheck, focused tests, full replay, and the full default tier are green.

Stage 3 / domain integrity: PASS. The new values are a test-fixture serialization schema and adapters to the existing production converter signature, not product domain identifiers or state machines; no new invalid product state, boolean state, validation leak, or swappable production boundary is introduced.

REVIEW_RESULT: stages=[{stage:spec,verdict:PASS,findings:[]},{stage:quality,verdict:PASS,findings:[]},{stage:domain,verdict:PASS,findings:[]}], overall_verdict=APPROVED, required_changes_count=0, blocking_findings_count=0. No recurring non-blocking finding was present to escalate.
